newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-GERMAN CUP SECOND ROUND SUMMARIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GERMAN CUP SECOND ROUND SUMMARIES.

text.p: Summaries on Wednesday from German cup second round matches played Tuesday:
Hertha Berlin 1 (Dinzey 2nd minute) VfB Stuttgart (Hagner 13th) 1. (Stuttgart won 6-5 on penalties). Halftime 1-1. Attendance 34,470.
Fortuna Duesseldorf (Nielsen 89th) 1 Hamburg 4 (Spoerl 16th, Breitenreiter 31st, Schupp 50th, Salihamidzic 86th). 0-2. 7,500.
Hanover 2 (Milovanic 20th penalty, Kovacec 31st) 1860 Munich 4 (Nowak 15th, Winkler 30th, Borimirow 69th, Cerny 84th). 2-2.
